text: .# Have you found the water chip yet?
source_text:
.
# Have you found the water chip yet?

text: I will. How are you doing?
source_text: I will. How are you doing?

text: Oh . . . you don't understand me. I guess we really don't have# much hope after all. Excuse me while I cry.
source_text:
Oh . . . you don't understand me. I guess we really don't have
# much hope after all. Excuse me while I cry.

text: Please find it before my baby dies of thirst.
source_text: Please find it before my baby dies of thirst.

text: You've got to find it! Don't let us die like this!
source_text: You've got to find it! Don't let us die like this!

text: Keep trying. I believe in you. I know you will do everything# you can to save us.
source_text:
Keep trying. I believe in you. I know you will do everything
# you can to save us.

text: I am afraid of what is happening. Someone has been stealing# water and now everyone is on edge.
source_text:
I am afraid of what is happening. Someone has been stealing
# water and now everyone is on edge.

text: Who would do such a thing?
source_text: Who would do such a thing?

text: Some people have been accused and fights have broken out# over it but nobody really knows.
source_text:
Some people have been accused and fights have broken out
# over it but nobody really knows.

text: Some people reported that their water had been stolen.# They weren't given more water but some friends shared# with them. After this everybody got very paranoid and# started guarding their water. A few days later# someone knocked the guard out in the ration supply area# and stole water.
source_text:
Some people reported that their water had been stolen.
# They weren't given more water but some friends shared
# with them. After this everybody got very paranoid and
# started guarding their water. A few days later
# someone knocked the guard out in the ration supply area
# and stole water.

text: That is terrible! What can I do?
source_text: That is terrible! What can I do?

text: Maybe you can stop whoever is doing this.
source_text: Maybe you can stop whoever is doing this.

text: 噢……你不明白。很抱歉我失态了，但是我现在真的很绝望。
source_text: 噢……你不明白。很抱歉我失态了，但是我现在真的很绝望。

text: 求求你在我孩子渴死前找到它。
source_text: 求求你在我孩子渴死前找到它。

text: 你会找到它的！别让我们就这样渴死！
source_text: 你会找到它的！别让我们就这样渴死！

text: 加油。我相信你，不论发生什么你都会赶回来救我们的。
source_text: 加油。我相信你，不论发生什么你都会赶回来救我们的。

text: 现在的情况很不好。已经有人开始偷水了，避难所的秩序也在崩溃的边缘。
source_text: 现在的情况很不好。已经有人开始偷水了，避难所的秩序也在崩溃的边缘。

text: 人们相互指责并爆发了群殴，但是没人了解真相。
source_text: 人们相互指责并爆发了群殴，但是没人了解真相。

text: 已经有许多人因储存水被盗而报警。幸亏一些朋友分给他们水他们才没有陷入窘困境。这也使得很多人变得过分敏感，开始日夜守着他们的水。几天后更发生了袭击配给供应区警卫人员的偷水事件。
source_text: 已经有许多人因储存水被盗而报警。幸亏一些朋友分给他们水他们才没有陷入窘困境。这也使得很多人变得过分敏感，开始日夜守着他们的水。几天后更发生了袭击配给供应区警卫人员的偷水事件。

text: 那太可怕了！我又能怎么办呢？
source_text: 那太可怕了！我又能怎么办呢？

text: 也许你能找出是谁干了这件事。
source_text: 也许你能找出是谁干了这件事。
